title: diptychandra aurantiaca
intro: Diptychandra aurantiaca, commonly known as the orange-flowered diptychandra, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate conditions such as fever and wounds.
